name: block-view
title: Block View
description: The frame TextEdit and MarkdownView draw a fenced block in when a blockViews entry renders its language: the label, Preview / Code, a split view on a wide editable block, Expand (a full-screen dialog with pan and pinch) and a ⋯ menu.

meta.whenToUse: Internal to TextEdit and MarkdownView: pass blockViews to either rather than mounting it.
meta.whenNotToUse: Showing code (CodeBlock) or a standalone diagram (MermaidBlock).
